packet.diagnosis: All five rows qualify under the deployed configuration. app/report.py negates every RETURN amount, regardless of feed or schema version. Reproduced contributions are A-1: 100000, A-2: 20000, A-3: -5000, A-4: 50000, A-5: -10000, totaling 155000 cents—40000 above the customer claim. Subtracting every return's absolute amount produces 115000, but that rule is undocumented. Preserving signed v1 amounts while subtracting v2 return magnitudes instead produces 125000, because A-3 contributes +5000. Neither interpretation is established by the supplied evidence. All five existing tests pass, but none covers v1 rows or negative RETURN amounts. The current calculation is established; its business correctness and a replacement total remain unresolved.
